title: Self-Evolving Recommendation System: End-To-End Autonomous Model Optimization With LLM Agents

mechanism.domainTask: Autonomous optimization of large-scale video recommendation models, including optimizers, architectures, and reward definitions
mechanism.populationDetail: The system generates multiple candidate configurations and stores experiment history in a journal, but does not describe a maintained evolutionary population or survivor pool.
mechanism.archiveDetail: No separate elite archive is described; offline winners are promoted to online testing and historical trials are retained in the Experiment Journal.
mechanism.replacementDetail: The Online Agent has a proposal queue and Experiment Journal, but these are orchestration/history structures rather than a specified evolutionary population.
mechanism.generationDetail: The LLM proposes changes as diffs against the current production configuration; delta-based edits are reported to be more reliable than regenerating the full configuration.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Offline/online metrics, proposal diffs, and completion statuses are serialized into the Experiment Journal and used as context for future proposals; metric values themselves are primary evaluation signals.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: The current model configuration is the edit base and past trials are contextual references; offline ranking selects which candidates advance to online testing, not which multiple parents are recombined.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: Dual-loop production recommendation optimization combines code/configuration generation, offline model training or signal analytics, deployment safety orchestration, and delayed online A/B feedback.

provenance.citationWarning: The current survey describes this paper as scheduling broad exploration earlier and conservative exploitation later, but the source prompt instead requests X/Y/Z exploration, exploitation, and innovation proposals within each batch and reports no temporal schedule. Recheck placement under state-independent fixed control. The linter role is also distinct from the core candidate-generation prompt.
